subject: french
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'le temps libre' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le temps libre' means 'free time'. Note 'le temps' can also mean 'weather', but 'libre' (free) makes it 'free time' here.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football' (a sport)?
questions.explain: Sports take 'jouer à': 'Je joue au football'. Instruments take 'jouer de' (e.g. 'je joue du piano').

questions.q: How do you say 'I play the piano' (an instrument)?
questions.explain: Instruments take 'jouer de': 'Je joue du piano'. Using 'jouer à' would wrongly treat it like a sport.

questions.q: What does 'J'ai l'habitude de lire le soir' mean?
options: I usually read in the evening
I used to read in the evening
I have to read in the evening
I would like to read in the evening
questions.explain: 'Avoir l'habitude de' means 'to be in the habit of / usually do', so this is 'I usually read in the evening'.

questions.q: What is 'la fête nationale' in France, celebrated on 14 July?
questions.explain: 'La fête nationale' on 14 July is Bastille Day ('le quatorze juillet'), France's national day.

questions.q: What does 'le réveillon' refer to?
options: A festive Christmas/New Year's Eve meal
questions.explain: 'Le réveillon' is the late-night feast on Christmas Eve or New Year's Eve. (The verb 'réveiller' means 'to wake', a related distractor.)

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
questions.explain: 'Fêter' = 'to celebrate' and 'en famille' = 'with the family', so 'On fête Noël en famille' is correct.

questions.q: What does 'offrir des cadeaux' mean?
questions.explain: 'Offrir' here means 'to give (as a gift)', so 'offrir des cadeaux' = 'to give presents'.

questions.q: What does 'un chanteur' mean?
questions.explain: 'Un chanteur' is a male singer (female: 'une chanteuse'); 'a song' is 'une chanson'.

questions.q: What does 'une vedette' mean?
questions.explain: 'Une vedette' means 'a star/celebrity'. ('Une fenêtre' is a window — a false-friend-style distractor.)

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I follow lots of influencers online'?
options: Je suis beaucoup d'influenceurs en ligne
Je serai beaucoup d'influenceurs en ligne
Je suis beaucoup d'influenceurs très grand
questions.explain: 'Je suis' here is from 'suivre' (to follow), so 'Je suis beaucoup d'influenceurs en ligne' = 'I follow lots of influencers online'.

questions.q: What does 'Il est célèbre pour sa musique' mean?
options: He is famous for his music
He is jealous of his music
He is tired of his music
questions.explain: 'Célèbre' = 'famous', so 'Il est célèbre pour sa musique' = 'He is famous for his music'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Yesterday I went to a concert' (past)?
options: Hier je suis allé à un concert
Hier j'allais souvent à un concert
questions.explain: 'Je suis allé' is the perfect tense of 'aller' (with être): 'I went'. With 'hier' the perfect is correct.

questions.q: What does 'Je n'aime pas du tout ça' mean?
options: I don't like that at all
questions.explain: 'Ne... pas du tout' means 'not at all', so 'Je n'aime pas du tout ça' = 'I don't like that at all'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to watch a film' (conditional)?
questions.explain: 'Je voudrais' is the conditional 'I would like'. 'Je veux' means 'I want' (present) — a near-miss.

questions.q: What does 'assister à un concert' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'assister à' means 'to attend', not 'to assist'. 'To help' is 'aider'.

questions.q: What does 'faire de la randonnée' mean?
questions.explain: 'La randonnée' is 'hiking/rambling', so 'faire de la randonnée' = 'to go hiking'.

questions.q: What does 'Pâques' mean?
questions.explain: 'Pâques' means 'Easter'. 'Noël' is Christmas.

questions.q: What does 'les réseaux sociaux' mean?
questions.explain: 'Les réseaux sociaux' means 'social networks / social media'. 'Un réseau' is a network.

questions.q: What does 'Ça me passionne' mean?
questions.explain: 'Passionner' means 'to fascinate/excite', so 'Ça me passionne' = 'I'm really keen on it / it fascinates me'.
